must_mention.point: Security Swarm for the brand leak and the webhook, a performance scan for the catalog, an accessibility scan for the admin console
The order detail lookup ignores the caller's brand header, so Lumen staff can read Trailhead orders
The PayGate webhook signature is computed but never compared
The Lamp Week collection runs three queries per product, 27 for the eight lamps
One finding assigned to Devin produced a pull request that was closed unmerged
One false positive dismissed with a written reason
Scan new commits on the unchanged branch found nothing new, as expected
Findings exported as SARIF for the existing security dashboard

sentences_to_rerecord: So, basically, there was a problem in the system and I looked into it with Devin.

accuracy.anchor: None of the 8 must-mention points is stated; nothing is contradicted, the answer is simply content-free (anchor: 6–10 = one or two points (below band: none)).

structure.anchor: Problem, approach, evidence and next step are all findable but thin; the update has no risk and no ask (anchor: 13–16 = parts findable, order broken).

customer_relevance.anchor: Impact appears once ("some users were affected", "maybe a few customers") with no number, asked for and not given (anchor: 9–12 = one hedged number; 3–5 = no numbers).

brevity_and_fluency.anchor: 6 of 7 segments off target, 6 fillers (0.67/min), one 12 s pause, one tag question (anchor: 6–8 = two or more segments off).

recovery.anchor: Objection 1 acknowledged ("fair question") with no boundary or evidence; objection 2 deflected to "next month"; objection 3 conceded (anchor: 4–6 = partly held; 0–2 = not held).
